title: A power-increasing wind turbine suitable for valley wind and power generation method
abstract: The invention discloses a power-enhancing wind turbine suitable for valley wind, comprising a tower, a nacelle is arranged on the top of the tower, an input end of the nacelle is connected with a wind wheel shaft, and a generator is arranged in the nacelle for converting the transmission of the wind wheel shaft. The mechanical energy is electric energy, the hub is connected to the shaft of the wind wheel, and the horizontal inflow blades are connected to the hub. The quasi-vertical inflow blade is a bionic airfoil, the trailing edge of the quasi-vertical inflow blade is connected with the horizontal inflow blade, and the windward surface of the quasi-vertical inflow blade is oriented towards the root direction of the horizontal inflow blade; The span direction of the blade for horizontal inflow is the benchmark. The quasi-vertical inflow blades on the same diameter have the same structure and the same airfoil chord length of each section. The airfoil chord length of the flow action blade is decreasing gradually. The invention increases the utilization rate of wind energy.
claims: 1. description: DescriptionPower-increasing wind turbine suitable for mountain valley wind and power generation methodTechnical FieldThe invention belongs to the technical field of renewable resource utilization, and particularly belongs to a power-increasing wind turbine suitable for mountain valley wind and a power generation method.BackgroundIn recent years, with the increasing problem of energy shortage, the awareness of environmental protection and the concept of sustainable development, the importance of clean energy and renewable energy is recognized. Wind energy has attracted attention due to the advantages of wide distribution, environmental protection, no pollution, cleanness, reproducibility and the like, and wind power generation has rapidly developed. The wind energy resources mainly comprise onshore wind power and offshore wind power. And onshore wind power is mainly built in the gobi, mountain bags and other areas with rare smoke. There are two main types of wind turbines in common use: horizontal axis wind turbines and vertical axis wind turbines. The horizontal axis wind turbine is widely applied because the generating efficiency is higher than that of the vertical axis wind turbine. The yaw system of the horizontal axis wind turbine can actively face wind, so that the wind turbine can reduce the loss of wind energy as much as possible and improve the utilization rate of the wind energy; the variable pitch system can enable blades of the wind turbine to rotate by a certain angle through information transmitted by the anemorumbometer, and the rotating speed and the power of a rotor of the wind turbine are controlled by changing the angle of the blades. However, in the area such as the hill bag, there are not only horizontal incoming flows but also mountain valley winds. The horizontal axis wind turbine which is installed in the mountainous bag and other zones in site can only convert most of the horizontal incoming flow, and cannot effectively utilize the mountain valley wind.Disclosure of InventionIn order to solve the problems in the prior art, the invention provides a power-increasing wind turbine suitable for mountain valley wind and a power generation method, and solves the problem that the wind energy is lost because the existing wind turbine cannot convert the mountain valley wind.In order to achieve the purpose, the invention provides the chord length at the joint of the first vertical blade and the horizontal inflow acting blade, C2 is the airfoil chord length of the second vertical blade, and X2 is the airfoil chord length at the the wind wheel shaft transmits mechanical energy to the generator, the generator converts the mechanical energy transmitted by the wind wheel shaft into electric energy, and the power generation of the power-increasing wind turbine is completed;when horizontal incoming wind blows to the power-increasing wind turbine and valley wind blows to the power-increasing wind turbine, the first variable pitch device controls the horizontal incoming wind to act on the blades to open the propellers, the second variable pitch device controls the pseudo-vertical incoming wind to act on the blades to open blades and the horizontal incoming wind acting blades are superposed and drive the wind wheel shaft to rotate, the wind wheel shaft transmits mechanical energy to the generator, and the generator converts the mechanical energy transmitted by the wind wheel shaft into electric energy to complete the power generation of the power-increasing wind turbine.Further, when the second variable pitch device adjusts the quasi-vertical incoming flow acting blade, the quasi-vertical incoming flow acting blade is always perpendicular to the valley wind.Compared with the prior art, the invention has at least the following beneficial effects:the invention provides a power-increasing wind turbine suitable for valley wind, which is characterized in that a horizontal incoming flow acting blade is connected to the circumference of a hub and used for converting the horizontal incoming flow wind, the horizontal incoming flow acting blade is connected with a pseudo-vertical incoming flow acting blade and used for converting the valley wind. The quasi-vertical incoming flow blade is equivalent to a resistance device, when a vertical incoming flow blows to the quasi-vertical incoming flow acting blade, a wind wheel is pushed to rotate, the blade tip of the horizontal incoming flow acting blade faces the blade root direction, and the airfoil chord length of the quasi-vertical incoming flow acting blade is gradually reduced.Furthermore, the main work output area of the horizontal incoming flow acting blade is beyond 30% of the blade span direction, and the pseudo-vertical incoming flow acting blade is added within 30% of the horizontal incoming flow acting blade close to the blade root to capture the valley wind, so that the wind turbine can capture the valley wind and the horizontal incoming flow wind at the same time, increase the resource utilization rate, and solve the problems that a wind turbine installed on a hillside is low in wind energy conversion efficiency and cannot fully and reasonably utilize the valley wind.Furthermore, the quasi-vertical incoming flow blade is divided into the first vertical blade and the second vertical blade mainly because the distance between the horizontal incoming flow acting blades along the blade tips to the blade roots is gradually reduced, and in order to capture and convert valley wind with greater efficiency and reasonably utilize the area within 30% of the blade roots, the first vertical blade and the second vertical blade are arranged according to the distance between the horizontal incoming flow acting blades along the blade tips to the blade roots.Furthermore, compared with a common straight-plate type blade and a semi-arc type blade, the quasi-vertical incoming flow blade adopting the bionic wing type has higher pneumatic performance, and can further improve the conversion of wind energy and further increase the working condition of the wind turbine.Furthermore, the horizontal inflow acting blades and the quasi-vertical acting blades are controlled by the variable pitch device, so that valley wind can be captured to the maximum extent, and the energy conversion efficiency of the wind turbine is the maximum.Furthermore, the arrangement of the two anemorumbometers can monitor the flow speed and the flow direction of horizontal and quasi-vertical incoming flows, so that a guiding effect is provided for blade pitch variation, valley wind can be efficiently captured, and the blade pitch variation under the action of horizontal incoming flows can be prevented from colliding with a tower barrel when driving the blades under the action of quasi-vertical incoming flows to rotate.When horizontal incoming wind blows to the power-increasing wind turbine, the blades are controlled to feather through the second variable pitch device under the action of the quasi-vertical incoming flow, so that the resistance borne by the power-increasing wind turbine is minimum, the stress of the whole blades of the power-increasing wind turbine is reduced, the load of the wind turbine is also reduced, the operation influence on the whole machine is reduced to the minimum, and the output power of the power-increasing wind turbine is increased along with the increase of the wind speed; when the horizontal incoming flow wind blows to the power-increasing wind turbine and the valley wind blows to the power-increasing wind turbine, the torques generated by the pseudo-vertical incoming flow acting blades and the horizontal incoming flow acting blades are superposed, so that the wind turbine shaft obtains a larger rotating speed. The utilization rate of wind energy is ensured, and the wind energy can be well applied and converted no matter horizontal incoming wind or mountain valley wind.Furthermore, the pseudo-vertical incoming flow acting blades are always perpendicular to the mountain valley wind, the pseudo-vertical incoming flow acting blades can obtain the maximum resistance, the generated resistance can push the wind wheel to rotate, the wind wheel rotates to drive the rotation of the rotating shaft of the wind wheel, and the rotating shaft can transmit the generated energy to the gear box and the generator, so that the conversion of the mountain valley wind energy is realized.DrawingsFIG. 1 is a schematic structural view of the present invention;FIG. 2 is a rear side view of FIG. 1;FIG. 3 is a flow exists in the valley, the horizontal incoming flow acts on the horizontal incoming flow acting blades 1 of the power-increasingwind turbine12, and the horizontal incoming flow acting blades 1 are connected through the hub 9. The horizontal inflow effect blade 1 is in the open state at the initial moment. In the oar opening state, the wind energy captured by the blades is the largest, and the power generated by the power-increasingwind turbine12 is also the largest; the quasi-verticalinflow acting blade13 is connected to the horizontal inflow acting blade 1 at the positions h2 and h1 away from the blade roots by the second pitch device 7. The quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 is feathered under the condition, and the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 can ensure that the power-increasingwind turbine12 has the minimum resistance and the influence on the operation of the whole machine is reduced to the minimum during feathering. The pseudo-vertical incomingflow effecting vanes13 are not active at this time. Therefore, the stress of the whole blade of the wind turbine can be reduced, the load of the wind turbine can be reduced, but the output power cannot be reduced due to the wind speed, so that the whole variable-pitch system can ensure rated power output on the premise of ensuring the safety of the unit, the unit can be completely feathered and shut down in extreme weather, the load of the unit is ensured to be minimum through the control of the yawing device and the variable-pitch device, the safety of the unit is ensured, and the variable-pitch system is of great importance to the safe operation of the whole wind turbine. When the wind speed reaches the starting wind speed, the horizontal incoming flow acting blades 1 rotate, meanwhile, the pseudo-vertical incomingflow acting blades13 are driven to rotate, and the pseudo-vertical incoming flow acting blades 1 do not work. The output power of the power-increasingwind turbine12 increases with the increase of the wind speed, and in order to enable the power-increasingwind turbine12 to capture more wind energy, the horizontal inflow acting blade 1 performs corresponding pitch variation through the first pitch variation device according to the information fed back by the first anemorumbometer, so that the wind turbine receives the most wind energy. At this time, the second pitch control device 7 of the pseudo-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 controls the pseudo-vertical incoming flow acting blade to change the pitch, so that the influence of the pseudo-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 on the horizontal incoming flow acting blade 1 is reduced, and the pseudo-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 is prevented from impacting the tower 4, thereby causing unnecessary danger. Therefore, the horizontal incoming flow can be effectively converted into mechanical energy, the mechanical energy is transmitted to a gear box and a generator which are positioned in thecabin8 through a wind wheel shaft, and finally the wind energy is converted into electric energy required by people.2) The wind blowing from the valley to the wind machine:when only valley wind exists in the valley, the valley wind acts on the power-increasingwind turbine12, the quasi-vertical incoming flow acts on theblade13 to be driven to rotate, theblade13 is driven to rotate by the rotation of the wind wheel shaft to convert wind energy, the quasi-vertical incoming flow acts on theblade13 to be driven to rotate, the resistance borne by the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 is the maximum, and in addition, the total resistance of the wind turbine blade can be further increased by the feathering of the horizontal incoming flow acting blade 1. In order to ensure that the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blades13 can have the maximum resistance at all times, thesecond anemorumbometer6 can monitor the wind speed and the wind direction of local valley wind in real time, so as to provide sufficient information for a variable pitch processing unit of the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blades13, meanwhile, the second variable pitch device 7 of the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blades13 can adjust the angle of the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blades13 to prevent the variable pitch from excessively colliding with the tower 4, and the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blades13 are made to be perpendicular to the incoming flow as far as possible on the basis, so that the blades can obtain the maximum resistance, the generated resistance can push the wind wheel to rotate, the wind wheel rotates to drive the wind wheel shaft to rotate, and the wind wheel shaft transmits the generated energy to the gear box and the generator, thereby realizing the conversion of the valley wind energy.3) Horizontal incoming flow and mountain valley wind blow to the wind turbine:when horizontal incoming flow and valley wind exist in the valley at the same time, the horizontal incoming flow and the valley wind in the valley act on the power-increasingwind turbine12, and the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 and the horizontal incoming flow acting blade 1 work in a matched mode to capture wind energy. Under the condition, the horizontal incoming flow acting blade 1 and the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 are both in oar opening, wind energy can be captured to the maximum when the horizontal incoming flow acting blade 1 is in oar opening, and the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 is arranged within 30% of the position, close to the blade root, of the horizontal incoming flow acting blade 1, and cannot affect acting on the horizontal incoming flow acting blade 1, so that when the horizontal incoming flow and the valley wind exist simultaneously, the torques generated by the quasi-vertical incomingflow acting blade13 and the horizontal incoming flow acting blade 1 are superposed, and a wind wheel shaft obtains a large rotating speed.
